answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 3148 Country: India Title: I want to do rabbit husbandry (khargosh) and to do its business, what is the ruling of the Shariah about it? Question: I want to do rabbit husbandry (khargosh) and to do its business, what is the ruling of the Shariah about it? Answer ID: 3148 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 213/199=B) Rabbit husbandry is allowed and its business is also halal . Contact your nearest Ulama about the nature of transaction and act accordingly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
